question: Approve the ideation baseline — resolver design (A), per-probe restated AC-2, and the added 2-file documentation surface — and advance this task to implementation?

artifacts.summary: Ideation baseline for the two stale pi-subagents doctor probes. Approach: both probes resolve from the installed package's own package.json — the extension from pi.extensions, the intercom bridge from exports["./intercom-bridge"]. AC-2 is restated per-probe because pi-subagents declares the bridge only in exports, so one shared entry cannot drive both lines; the restatement is proposed, not pre-approved. Surface: 2 code files (internal/cli/pi.go, internal/cli/pi_frontdoor_test.go), net +60 to +90 LOC at +/-25 percent; plus a new 2-file documentation surface (docs/runtime-support.md, docs/site/contributing/adding-a-runtime.md) carrying four one-line --extension path edits, which exceeds the seed's 2-file code estimate and is flagged for this gate. Primary proof owner is internal/cli/pi_frontdoor_test.go, reshaped to a manifest-driven fixture whose expected paths derive from the written package.json. Deterministic Go tests only; no live lane needed.
